data.value: Favorite current player is Stephen Curry
Favorite all time player is Steve Nash

Basketball is an affordable, simple, and infinitely complex game. It allows the player to grow in so many different ways. An underrated quality that comes from playing basketball is leadership. A well informed player can point out weaknesses and strengths for his or her team. They can motivate players, and get the best out of everyone. At that point, they are fine tuning and putting their leadership on display.

I have been playing basketball since I was 10 years old. Basketball taught me what dedication to something can do. It taught me leadership in addition to the ability to recognize imperfections in myself.
